quote: Pricing of drug testing services is a significant factor often considered by customers in selecting a drug testing laboratory.
why: 「Pricing」が検査所選びの大きな要因と述べるだけ。顧客が乗り換え費用を負う機構の名指しは無い。

quote: it is unlikely that the customer will later switch to a competing alternative. In many cases, the regulatory license for the product will specify the products qualified for use in the process. Obtaining the regulatory approvals needed for a change in the manufacturing process is time consuming, expensive and uncertain.
why: 顧客工程は「products qualified」が指定され、変更の「regulatory approvals」は「expensive」と断定＝顧客側の再認定。

quote: As a result, as of January 1, 2001, all of APS’s retail customers were eligible to choose alternate energy suppliers.
why: 顧客は「eligible to choose alternate energy suppliers」とあるだけで、顧客が負う乗り換え費用の機構は無い。

quote: We compete primarily on the basis of reputation, product quality, reliability of service, delivery and price.
why: 「compete primarily on the basis of ... price」という一般的な競争記述のみで、乗り換え費用の機構は無い。

quote: Upon the expiration or loss of patent protection for a product, especially a small molecule product, we can lose the major portion of revenues for that product in a very short period of time.
why: 特許切れで売上の大半を「in a very short period」に失う＝顧客はすぐ移る。顧客側の乗り換え費用は無い。

quote: Blu-ray Disc players continue to represent an important source of revenue within our CE market, as these players are required by the applicable standards of the Blu-ray Disc Association to include the Company Digital technology for primary audio content and our the Company Digital Plus technology for secondary audio content.
why: 規格で「required ... to include」＝顧客の製品への組込が必須。顧客側の再認定の断定は無いので70。

quote: In addition, a Customer Communications telecommunications client, representing approximately 6.6% of 2009 annual Customer Communications operating revenues, terminated its contract and internalized bill production processing in April 2010, which resulted in a contract termination payment to the Company of approximately $63.0 million.
why: 顧客が契約を解除し内製化した際に「contract termination payment」を払った＝複数年契約の拘束を顧客が負う。

quote: We sell our products in intensely competitive markets.
why: 「intensely competitive markets」という一般的な競争記述のみ。顧客が乗り換え費用を負う機構の名指しは無い。

quote: Anchor tenant leases are typically for 10 to 25 years, with one or more renewal options available to the lessee upon expiration of the initial lease term.
why: 核テナントの賃貸借は「10 to 25 years」＝テナント（顧客）が複数年の支払義務を負う。再認定ではないので70。

quote: the Company believes that the principal points of competition are product quality, price, design and engineering capabilities, product development, conformity to customer specifications, quality of post-sale support, timeliness of delivery, and effectiveness of our distribution channels.
why: 「principal points of competition are product quality, price」等の一般的な競争記述のみで機構は無い。

quote: We may not win this competitive procurement if another provider offers to provide the same or similar services at a lower cost.
why: 入札で「another provider」が「lower cost」なら置き換わる＝価格で乗り換え可能。摩擦の機構の名指しは無い。

quote: Generally, these agreements are terminable by either party upon 60 days written notice without penalty.
why: 契約は「terminable by either party」「without penalty」＝顧客は60日前の通知で違約金なしに解約でき、摩擦は無い。
